Searching for references to the store.Memo struct across the repository.

Identifying Go packages that reference `store.Memo`. The definition itself is in `store`, while database drivers in `store/db/mysql` and `store/db/postgres` are also affected.

Additional affected packages include `store/db/sqlite`, `store/test`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, and `server/runner/memopayload`. `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` also accesses `GetMemo` and `ListMemos` without direct `store.Memo` typing.

Several API service files reference `GetMemo` and `ListMemos` without direct `store.Memo` typing. These include `attachment_service.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`, `user_service_stats.go`, `sse_service_test.go`, and various test files. They fall within the already identified packages. SQLite may rely on a default `GetMemo` implementation from `store/memo.go` instead of its own driver method.

`cmd/memos` likely only instantiates the store and does not consume the struct directly. Tests that construct or assert on `store.Memo` should also be included, since field changes would affect them.

Expanding the search to additional packages that may reference `store.Memo`: `store/cache`, internal packages, `plugin/webhook`, and `instance_stats`. Also verifying whether `frontend.go` and the SQLite driver access the struct directly.
